actual_channel: Original ordered cutoff divisors x,y with N(xy)<=Z. For each intermediate d exactly assign its primes to x,y or neither. Expand the unused residual squarefree condition by mu(r) and b times r^2, keeping all masks and allowing overlap of r,b. Use nonprincipal primitive Poisson for small r and the pinned physical sixth-free norm with v2 and the sixth-power factors fixed for large r.
new_budget: Uniform positive normalized bound for each d: (Z/Nd)[R^2/C0+A2 Phi6(A1,C0)] with M4(W)^2 and subpowers. Mixed C0=D^(31/66) yields Z D^(23/33) and power 493/660 at Z=D^(1/20), including a pivot neighborhood. At d=1 the target is equivalent to controlling the complementary amplitude. No fixed-field 7/8 input.
remaining_cross: Across signed d the complementary positive norm is still open at target scale. The absolute Cauchy cross bound with inherited power 13/12 is D^(235/264+eps) sqrt(Z), which exceeds target. Pure budget optimizes at 27/32 for Z=1 and fails target.
limits: Larger cutoff products, full small-annular signed form, determinant and zero locations, Lean and GRH remain open. No public release.
